dashboard.when: their Projects home: their open issues, their projects, the active sprints and how each burns down

my-work.when: everything on their plate across projects — assigned, watching, in review for them

activity.when: recent activity in Projects, or one project's or one issue's history

settings.when: the business's Projects defaults: timezone, sprint length, the point scale, the stale threshold, attachment limit, default visibility

tokens.when: their own access tokens for the two MCP servers

projects-list.when: the projects, as cards by department, open or private, active or archived

project-view.when: one project's overview: lead, team, active sprint, epics with progress, recent activity

project-edit.when: to change a project's name, description, department, lead, customer, visibility, board mode or swimlane

project-settings.when: a project's workflow, board, labels, components, team and roles, visibility, archive

project-backlog.when: the backlog in rank order with the next sprints' boxes above it: estimate, rank, move to a sprint

project-board.when: the board: the active sprint by column and swimlane, WIP counts, blocked marks

project-sprints.when: the project's sprints: future, active, closed, with their points

project-epics.when: the epics as cards with progress bars

project-issues.when: the issue table with filters and saved filters

project-reports.when: velocity, burndown, cycle time, cumulative flow, scope change

issue-view.when: one issue: fields, description, subtasks, links, attachments, checklist, worklogs, comments, history, watch

issue-add.when: to create an issue — the type decides the fields

issue-edit.when: to change an issue's summary, description, type, priority, points, estimate, assignee, epic, component, labels, due date

sprint-view.when: one sprint: goal, dates, burndown, its issues by status, scope changes, and to close it with carry-over

sprint-add.when: to create a sprint in a project

sprint-edit.when: to change a sprint's name, goal or dates

epic-view.when: one epic: its summary, progress, and its issues

epic-add.when: to create an epic in a project

epic-edit.when: to change an epic's name, summary, colour, target date or status
